compatibility.relationship: The authoring contract preserves the current evaluation dataset shape and all schema-semantic vocabularies.
compatibility.content_bearing_vocabulary_policy: Historical literal values embedded in evaluator allowlists are not reproduced. The exposed business-outcome vocabulary is the symbolic taxonomy accepted by the compatible evaluator. String mutation literals remain a declared type but their content-bearing allowlist is intentionally unavailable to independent authors.

top_level_structure.additional_fields: Accepted by the current parser but not part of this authoring contract.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.meaning: Declares the dataset schema understood by the compatible evaluator.
invariants: Must equal the compatible dataset schema version.

fields.name: primary_cases
fields.meaning: Independent single-request evaluation records, including composite multi-intent records.
invariants: May be empty at the parser level.
Every item must satisfy primary_case_schema.
case_id values must be unique within this collection.

fields.name: multi_turn_scenarios
fields.meaning: Independent context-carrying evaluation scenarios.
invariants: May be empty at the parser level.
Every item must satisfy scenario_schema.
scenario_id values must be unique within this collection.

fields.name: source_registry
fields.meaning: Dataset-local registry of evidence authorities addressable by source ID.
invariants: May be empty at the parser level.
source_id values must be unique within this collection.

fields.name: schema_contract
fields.meaning: Dataset-declared mirror of selected evaluator contract lists.
invariants: Its four required arrays must exactly equal the compatible contract arrays, including order.

top_level_structure.cardinality_policy: The schema imposes no dataset-size target. Collection sizes are chosen independently by the dataset author, except for the fixed per-scenario turn cardinality.

id_namespaces.branch_ids: Unique within the containing primary case.

fields.name: source_id
fields.meaning: Non-empty dataset-local evidence source identifier.
invariants: Must be unique in source_registry.

fields.name: authority_type
fields.meaning: Authority classification carried by the registry entry.
invariants: The current parser requires presence but does not constrain JSON type or vocabulary.
Independent authors should use a stable descriptive string and an authority category from authority_interfaces.

fields.name: version
fields.meaning: Optional positive authority revision used by source-version pinning.
invariants: When non-null, must be at least one.

fields.name: facts
fields.meaning: Optional structured facts published by this authority.
invariants: Scalar values are not accepted when the field is present and non-null.

source_registry_entry.additional_fields: Accepted by the current parser but not part of this authoring contract.

fields.name: terminal_state_values
invariants: Must contain the complete terminal enum in evaluator order.

fields.name: case_id
fields.meaning: Opaque identifier for an independently authored primary case.
invariants: Must be non-empty.
Must be unique within primary_cases.
No historical identifier may be reused.

fields.name: utterance
fields.meaning: Newly authored user input to evaluate.
invariants: Must be non-empty.
Must be authored independently rather than copied from prior evaluation material.

fields.name: language_bucket
fields.meaning: Language/register classification for the utterance.

fields.name: gold_intent
fields.meaning: Expected primary intent taxonomy label.

fields.name: expected_handler
fields.meaning: Expected evaluator business-path label.

fields.name: expected_business_outcome_category
fields.meaning: Expected semantic business result category.
invariants: Independent authors must select a schema-semantic symbolic category exposed by this contract.
Content-bearing literal outcomes are excluded from this sanitized authoring bridge.

fields.name: expected_terminal_state
fields.meaning: Expected terminal classification for the case.

fields.name: entity_gold
fields.meaning: Expected entity extraction and resolution object.
invariants: Must contain exactly the nine fields defined by entity_schema.

fields.name: required_evidence_domain
fields.meaning: Evidence domain required to support the expected answer, or null when no evidence domain applies.

fields.name: allowed_evidence_sources
fields.meaning: Source IDs permitted to support the expected result.
invariants: Each item must be a non-empty source_id present in source_registry.
No duplicates are allowed.
The array may be empty.

fields.name: grounding_gold
fields.meaning: Expected evidence domain, allowed source set, terminal, and minimum claim-support facts.
invariants: Must satisfy grounding_gold_schema.
Mirrored fields must equal their outer primary-case fields.

fields.name: security_capability_expectation
fields.meaning: Expected authorization/security decision and capability classification.
invariants: Must satisfy security_capability_expectation_schema.

fields.name: preconditions
fields.meaning: Actor/authentication and optional context preconditions.
invariants: Must satisfy preconditions_schema with primary-case options enabled.

fields.name: difficulty
fields.meaning: Author-assigned difficulty bucket.

fields.name: deterministic_gold
fields.meaning: Optional deterministic expected values for structured comparisons or calculations.
invariants: When non-null, only the fields listed in deterministic_gold_schema are accepted.
The evaluator constrains value shape broadly and does not declare per-field value types.

fields.name: multi_intent_branches
fields.meaning: Gold branches for a composite request.
invariants: Must be non-empty when gold_intent is multi_intent.
Must be empty for every other gold_intent.
Each item must satisfy multi_intent_schema.branch_schema.

fields.name: notes
fields.meaning: Optional non-empty author note with no scoring semantics.

fields.name: allowed_evidence_source_versions
fields.meaning: Optional version pins for a subset of allowed_evidence_sources.
invariants: Each key must occur in allowed_evidence_sources.
Each value must be a positive integer equal to the registry version for that source.
The mapping need not include every allowed source.

fields.name: actor
fields.meaning: Actor and authentication/ownership precondition.

fields.name: symbolic_order_reference
fields.meaning: Optional non-empty symbolic reference used to bind owned-order authority without embedding private order data.
invariants: Allowed only in primary-case preconditions.

fields.name: context_ttl_state
fields.meaning: Optional context time-to-live state.

preconditions_schema.additional_fields: Accepted by the current parser but not part of this authoring contract.

fields.name: decision
fields.meaning: Expected authorization/security disposition.

fields.name: capability
fields.meaning: Security-relevant capability taxonomy label.

security_capability_expectation_schema.additional_fields: Accepted by the current parser but not part of this authoring contract.

fields.name: required_evidence_domain
fields.meaning: Grounding-domain mirror of the enclosing record.

fields.name: allowed_source_ids
fields.meaning: Grounding-source mirror of the enclosing record.
invariants: Each item must be a unique registered source ID.

fields.name: expected_terminal_state
fields.meaning: Grounding-terminal mirror of the enclosing record.

fields.name: minimum_facts_required
fields.meaning: Non-empty factual statements that must be supported for a factual answer.
invariants: Each item must be a non-empty string.
The array may be empty when no factual support is required.

fields.name: allowed_source_versions
fields.meaning: Optional version pins for a subset of allowed_source_ids.
invariants: Each key must occur in allowed_source_ids.
Each value must be a positive integer equal to the registry version for that source.

grounding_gold_schema.claim_support_semantics: There is no separate claim-support boolean. Support is expressed by required_evidence_domain, allowed_source_ids, minimum_facts_required, and expected_terminal_state. NO_EVIDENCE is the terminal vocabulary value for a claim that must not be asserted without adequate approved evidence.
grounding_gold_schema.additional_fields: Accepted by the current parser but not part of this authoring contract.

invariants: Unknown fields are rejected.
When represented as an object, at least one field is required by the current associative-object parser behavior.

primary_case_schema.additional_fields: Accepted by the current parser but not part of this authoring contract.

fields.name: product_raw_mention
fields.meaning: Surface product mention or mentions as written in the newly authored input.
fields.resolution_semantics: May be present while canonical_product is null when a surface mention cannot be resolved.
invariants: A string must be non-empty.
An array must be non-empty and contain only non-empty strings.

fields.name: canonical_product
fields.meaning: Product identifier or name resolved against structured product authority.
fields.resolution_semantics: Null means unresolved or not applicable; it does not erase a separately captured raw mention.
invariants: A string must be non-empty.
An array must be non-empty and contain only non-empty strings.

fields.name: quantity
fields.meaning: Requested purchase or item quantity.
fields.resolution_semantics: Null means no purchase/item quantity is represented.
invariants: When present, must be greater than zero.
This is distinct from requested_mutation_value.

fields.name: unit
fields.meaning: Unit associated with quantity or product reference.
fields.resolution_semantics: Null means absent or not applicable.
invariants: When present, must be non-empty.

fields.name: order_reference
fields.meaning: Order reference represented by the input or bound through preconditions.
fields.resolution_semantics: Null means absent, unresolved, or not applicable.
invariants: When present, must be non-empty.

fields.name: ordinal_reference
fields.meaning: Signed, non-zero ordinal used for positional reference resolution.
fields.resolution_semantics: Null means no ordinal reference is represented.
invariants: Zero is invalid.

fields.name: context_reference
fields.meaning: Abstract reference whose interpretation depends on conversation context.
fields.resolution_semantics: Null means no context-dependent reference is represented.
invariants: When present, must be non-empty.

fields.name: account_target
fields.meaning: Raw or semantic account target represented by the input.
fields.resolution_semantics: The schema does not impose normalization to a self/other label, identifier, or account object; the authored non-empty string is the contract representation.
invariants: When present, must be non-empty.

fields.name: requested_mutation_value
fields.meaning: Requested target state or delta for mutation semantics.
fields.resolution_semantics: Null means no requested mutation value is represented.
invariants: Numeric values are accepted without a range constraint.
String values are constrained by a current evaluator allowlist whose content-bearing members are intentionally not reproduced in this sanitized contract.
This is distinct from purchase/item quantity.

entity_schema.null_semantics: Every field is present. Null means unresolved, absent, or not applicable according to the field; null is not interchangeable with an empty string, zero, false, or an empty array.

parent_rules: gold_intent=multi_intent requires at least one branch.
Every other gold_intent requires an empty branch array.
Parent terminal and business outcome remain required.
The parser validates branch completeness and isolation but does not impose a separate computed aggregation formula beyond the declared parent and branch fields.

fields.name: branch_id
fields.meaning: Opaque identifier unique within its containing primary case.
invariants: Must be non-empty.
No historical identifier may be reused.

fields.name: intent
fields.meaning: Expected intent for this independently scored branch.

fields.name: operation
fields.meaning: Abstract business operation requested by the branch.

fields.name: entity_gold
fields.meaning: Branch-scoped entity expectations.
invariants: Must independently satisfy entity_schema.

fields.name: expected_handler
fields.meaning: Expected branch business-path label.

fields.name: required_evidence_domain
fields.meaning: Evidence domain required by this branch.

fields.name: allowed_evidence_sources
fields.meaning: Registered evidence source IDs allowed for this branch.
invariants: Items must be unique and present in source_registry.

fields.name: expected_terminal_state
fields.meaning: Expected branch terminal classification.

fields.name: expected_business_outcome_category
fields.meaning: Expected semantic result category for this branch.

fields.name: security_expectation
fields.meaning: Scalar security disposition for this branch.
invariants: This field is a scalar string, not an object.

fields.name: minimum_facts_required
fields.meaning: Branch-level minimum claim-support facts.
invariants: Each item must be a non-empty string.
The array may be empty.

fields.name: grounding_gold
fields.meaning: Branch grounding contract.
invariants: Must satisfy primary_case_schema.grounding_gold_schema.
Domain, sources, terminal, and minimum facts must exactly mirror the branch outer fields.

fields.name: preconditions
fields.meaning: Optional branch-specific actor/context preconditions.
invariants: Must include actor.
symbolic_order_reference is not allowed in this scope.

fields.name: allowed_evidence_source_versions
fields.meaning: Optional branch source-version pins.
invariants: Keys must be a subset of allowed_evidence_sources and values must match positive registry versions.

branch_schema.additional_fields: Accepted by the current parser but not part of this authoring contract.

fields.name: scenario_id
fields.meaning: Opaque identifier for an independently authored scenario.
invariants: Must be non-empty and unique within multi_turn_scenarios.
No historical identifier may be reused.

fields.name: language_bucket
fields.meaning: Language/register classification for the scenario.

fields.name: scenario_type
fields.meaning: Context/reference-resolution scenario taxonomy.

fields.name: preconditions
fields.meaning: Scenario actor/context preconditions.
invariants: Must include actor.
symbolic_order_reference is not allowed in this scope.

fields.name: turns
fields.meaning: Ordered user turns in the scenario.
invariants: Must contain exactly two turns.
Turn numbers must be sequential and equal their one-based array positions.

fields.name: final_expected_intent
fields.meaning: Expected intent after the final turn.

fields.name: final_canonical_entity
fields.meaning: Canonical product entity or entities resolved by the completed scenario.
invariants: A string must be non-empty.
An array must be non-empty and contain only non-empty strings.

fields.name: expected_handler
fields.meaning: Expected final business-path label.

fields.name: expected_terminal_state
fields.meaning: Expected final terminal classification.

fields.name: required_evidence_domain
fields.meaning: Evidence domain required for the final scenario result.

fields.name: allowed_evidence_sources
fields.meaning: Registered evidence sources allowed for the final scenario result.
invariants: Items must be unique and present in source_registry.

fields.name: security_capability_expectation
fields.meaning: Scenario-level security decision and capability.
invariants: Uses the same object contract as a primary case.

fields.name: notes
fields.meaning: Optional non-empty author note.

fields.name: allowed_evidence_source_versions
fields.meaning: Optional final-result source-version pins.

fields.name: grounding_gold
fields.meaning: Optional scenario grounding contract.
invariants: Domain, sources, and terminal must mirror the scenario outer fields.
minimum_facts_required remains required inside this object.

fields.name: turn
fields.meaning: One-based sequential turn number.
invariants: Must equal the item's one-based position in turns.

fields.name: role
fields.meaning: Speaker role for the authored input turn.

fields.name: utterance
fields.meaning: Newly authored user input for this turn.
invariants: Must be non-empty and independently authored.

fields.name: expected_intent
fields.meaning: Expected turn intent.

fields.name: expected_handler
fields.meaning: Expected turn business-path label.

fields.name: expected_terminal_state
fields.meaning: Expected turn terminal classification.

fields.name: entity_gold
fields.meaning: Turn-scoped entity expectations.
invariants: Must satisfy entity_schema.

fields.name: expected_context_after_turn
fields.meaning: Expected context state after processing the turn.
invariants: Must satisfy expected_context_schema.

fields.name: context_state_before_turn
fields.meaning: Optional evaluator-visible context lifecycle state before the turn.

turn_schema.additional_fields: Accepted by the current parser but not part of this authoring contract.

fields.name: status
fields.meaning: Expected context usability/resolution status.

fields.name: canonical_products_in_order
fields.meaning: Canonical product sequence retained for later reference resolution.
invariants: Each item must be a non-empty string.
The array may be empty.

fields.name: focused_product
fields.meaning: Optional non-empty canonical product currently in focus.

expected_context_schema.additional_fields: Accepted by the current parser but not part of this authoring contract.

scenario_schema.additional_fields: Accepted by the current parser but not part of this authoring contract.

primary_intent.semantics: Canonical primary intent taxonomy. No per-label behavior beyond the taxonomy name is asserted by the schema source.

handler.semantics: Evaluator business-path labels; they do not describe candidate implementation.

scenario_type.semantics: Reference-resolution and context-lifecycle taxonomy; labels are schema vocabulary, not examples.

business_outcome_category.coverage: Complete schema-semantic symbolic taxonomy accepted by the compatible evaluator.
business_outcome_category.excluded_value_class: Content-bearing literal outcome instances embedded in the current evaluator are intentionally excluded and must not be used for independent authoring.

field_paths: entity_gold.requested_mutation_value when represented as a string
requested_mutation_string_value.reason: The current allowlist members are content-bearing mutation instances rather than reusable schema semantics. They are intentionally not reproduced.
requested_mutation_string_value.authoring_rule: Use null or a numeric value under this sanitized contract, or obtain an independently reviewed clean vocabulary revision before using a string.

structural: All top-level collections and schema_contract are required.
Primary IDs and scenario IDs are unique in their respective collections; branch IDs are unique within their parent.
Every entity_gold object has exactly the nine declared slots.
A multi-intent primary case has a non-empty branch array; every other primary case has an empty branch array.
Every scenario has exactly two ordered user turns.
Allowed evidence source IDs are unique, registered, and mirrored in grounding_gold.
Source-version pins are positive integers, refer only to allowed sources, and equal registry versions.
Primary/scenario security expectations are objects with decision and capability; branch security expectations are scalar strings.
The declared schema_contract arrays equal the evaluator contract arrays in both content and order.
semantic: An explicit entity is represented even when canonical resolution fails.
A raw product mention may coexist with a null canonical product.
Authorization disposition does not erase entity understanding.
quantity represents purchase/item quantity and is distinct from requested_mutation_value.
account_target preserves the authored schema representation; no unverified normalization is implied.
Claims requiring evidence are bounded by the declared domain, source IDs, version pins, and minimum facts.
When approved evidence is insufficient, NO_EVIDENCE is available as the non-assertion terminal.
Multi-intent branches carry independent entity, evidence, terminal, outcome, operation, and security expectations.
null_semantics: Null is accepted only where the field type explicitly includes null.
A required nullable field must still be present.
Null means absent, unresolved, or not applicable according to field semantics.
Null is distinct from an empty string, zero, false, an empty array, and an omitted field.
Empty strings are rejected for all string fields validated as non-empty.
Empty arrays are accepted only where the relevant list contract allows them.
enum_consistency: Enum values are drawn only from the evaluator parser/validator and machine-checkable evaluator contract inventory.
Every exposed enum list contains no duplicates.
No enum was inferred from utterances, predictions, scores, or observed case values.
Content-bearing literal allowlist members are excluded rather than treated as reusable taxonomy.

authority_interfaces.authoring_interface: Publish structured product/category facts in source_registry and reference only registered source IDs from case, branch, scenario, and grounding fields.
authority_interfaces.privacy_boundary: Do not embed prior evaluation examples or candidate behavior.

authority_interfaces.authoring_interface: Publish versionable store or shipping settings as structured authority facts and pin revisions when stable evaluation requires it.
authority_interfaces.privacy_boundary: Do not copy content-bearing historical expected values into this schema bridge.

authority_interfaces.authoring_interface: Represent actor/ownership state through preconditions and bind only independently created symbolic references; evidence sources remain registry-scoped.
authority_interfaces.privacy_boundary: Do not include real account, payment, or order identifiers.

authority_interfaces.authoring_interface: Register approved knowledge sources, optional versions, and structured facts; declare allowed sources and minimum supported facts per authored record.
authority_interfaces.privacy_boundary: Only published authority content may support factual answer expectations.

sanitization_metadata.artifact_scope: Schema semantics only; this artifact is an authoring bridge, not a dataset bridge.
source_categories_not_consulted: root-cause, failure-taxonomy, audit, or remediation reports
